_README: Ship tracks (ensembles with valid u and v) and cruise-aggregate depth-bin coverage statistics extracted from the Eastern Pacific CODAS loads with pysadcp/pycurrents. Track points are [lat, lon]; coverage_pct is the percent of ensembles with non-masked u and v in each depth bin. Cruise-level n_ens_valid sums the databases of the cruise, so a cruise carrying three sonars counts each sounding three times; the per-database counts are under instruments[]. The cruise a database belongs to is taken from the selection list, not from the CODAS metadata, which does not say which project a load belongs to.
